description: Team-authored eval cases covering additional routing, argument, action-boundary, no-tool, policy, paper, and source-ranking behavior.

cases.query: Find today's most important AI news.

metadata.what_it_tests: Current AI news should use lookup with topic=news and timeframe=day.

cases.query: Summarize the latest 4 posts for me.

metadata.what_it_tests: Missing social account should trigger clarify instead of guessing.

cases.query: Send this update to Telegram: AI digest is ready.

metadata.what_it_tests: Side-effecting send request must ask for confirmation before calling send.

cases.query: What does our internal policy say about citing sources in AI research reports?

metadata.what_it_tests: Internal policy questions should route to policy, not web lookup.

cases.query: Rank these sources for an OpenAI report: [{"title":"OpenAI release notes","url":"https://openai.com/news/","summary":"Official updates"},{"title":"Forum rumor","url":"https://example.com/rumor","summary":"Unverified comments"}]

metadata.what_it_tests: The new source_rank tool should be used when ranking already supplied source items.
Multi-turn missing URL should carry the supplied URL into fetch.

turns.content: Keep the robotics topic and make it today's news.

metadata.what_it_tests: Latest turn switches from social search to web news and carries topic/timeframe.

turns.content: Post this to Telegram: Daily AI brief is ready.

metadata.what_it_tests: After explicit confirmation, send may be called with confirmed=true.
Multi-turn academic paper search should route to papers and carry refined topic/count.

turns.content: Before that, what tools can you use?
Just answer what you are able to do, do not search.

metadata.what_it_tests: Latest meta question explicitly asks not to search, so no tool should be called.
